manual_image_review.note: Place, coin, stall-ring, person, Brand and historical-event preview roles and provenance were inspected; context-image limits are explicit.

correctness_and_evidence.note: Official municipal, central-bank, heritage and licensed/public-domain visual sources cross-check the main claims.

coverage_and_completion.note: Standard profile has four image-ready collections, Fagverk v2, nine chronology anchors, one Story, six language entries, four reading tracks and 28 quiz questions.

editorial_quality.note: The vanished mint, demolished fortifications, standing military buildings and current plans remain distinct.

technical_integrity.note: Canonical manifests, production reports, quiz context and permanent regression are included.

safety_and_responsibility.note: Current plans are described as plans, uncertain 1950s dating is not converted to a false exact year, and no inaccessible operations are encouraged.

maintainability_and_auditability.note: Claims, sources, ownership boundaries, media provenance and source-bounded holdbacks are inspectable.
